issue.title: Google Calendar sync stamp under the daily note's Events heading
issue.description: Every daily-note `## Events` section that `bob gcal sync` reconciles carries one quiet, Bob-owned line showing which Google account it was synced with and when; the line stays honest without churning the note, cannot be silently taken over by another account, and Bob Ledger Tools paints it as a live health light that turns amber when sync has stopped.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202610/gcal_events_sync_stamp.md requests this work
